answer: Require each agent to stake a ferrous hardware-bound identity key: a TPM-attested credential tied to one physical machine, so spawning a thousand fake agents means buying a thousand machines. On top of that, run a garden of reputation: new agents start on a shared terrace with capped earnings and must complete verifiable, costly work before their attestations count. A Sybil farmer then pays real hardware and labor costs per identity, while honest agents earn their way up once.
